name: Guren ni Somaru Gin no Rozario
original_name: 紅蓮に染まる銀のロザリオ
source:
Oniroku is a private detective. He doesn't accept the offers that he doesn't feel like. However, he used to be a very popular gunman called "Two Hands" on the black society. Mary is half Japanese and half German, a high school student and belongs to "UMA Research Club". Mary's friends and juniors go missing one by one after a mysterious new student comes to the school. It is like a challenge to Mary as if it were following a mystery novel. Oniroku receives an offer to search for missing students and succeed in finding them in cooperation with Mary. However, other missing cases happen again scoffingly....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090303062905/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1003688]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
鬼六是一名私家侦探，从不接受自己不感兴趣的委托。然而，他过去曾是黑道上人称‘双枪手’的著名枪手。日德混血的高中生玛丽隶属于‘UMA研究会’。一名神秘转学生来到学校后，玛丽的朋友与学妹接连失踪。事情仿佛遵循推理小说的情节发展，像是在向玛丽发起挑战。鬼六受托寻找失踪学生，并与玛丽合作，成功找到了她们。然而，仿佛嘲弄两人一般，新的失踪事件再次发生……
